result.description: HelioArc Nautilus Forge 27Q is a fictional 27-inch IPS studio monitor built for color-critical illustration, layout, and editorial review. It features a 2560x1440 native resolution, 98% DCI-P3 coverage, factory-calibrated Delta E < 2 tuning, USB-C input with 65W power delivery, and a matte anti-glare panel designed for mixed-light workspaces. The display includes adjustable height, tilt, swivel, and pivot support, plus dual HDMI and DisplayPort connectivity for desktop creative setups.
